questions: Is a progression defined as an arithmetic progression, a geometric progression, or any sequence with a constant difference/ratio?
If arithmetic, must the common difference be an integer, or can it be any real number given integer elements?
If geometric, must the common ratio be an integer, rational, or any real number?
Does a progression require strictly increasing/decreasing, or can it be constant (e.g., all elements equal)?
Are single-element sequences considered progressions? (But N≥2 per constraints.)
Should the output be case-sensitive exactly 'Yes'/'No' or could 'YES'/'NO' be acceptable?
Is a progression defined only by first two terms determining the rule, or must all consecutive pairs satisfy it?
Does 'positive integers' include zero? (Already clarified as no.)
